summary: Honour Muay Thai is a Muay Thai gym near Ao Nang, Krabi offering twice-daily training six days a week, with on-site rooms and meal packages.

facts.label: Daily training price
facts.value: 500 THB for one session a day, 800 THB for two
facts.quote: Daily Training costs: 500 THB for one session/day, 800 THB two sessions/day.

facts.label: Training schedule
facts.value: Training every day from Monday to Saturday
facts.quote: Training sessions take place every day from monday to Saturday.

facts.label: Session times
facts.value: Morning training starts 8:00 am, afternoon at 4:00 pm

facts.label: Accommodation
facts.value: Rooms next to the gym with Wi-Fi, a/c or fan
facts.quote: Room are next to the gym, have Wi-Fi throughout, with several options to suit.

facts.label: Room types
facts.value: Two 4-person rooms, 2 single rooms and 3 double rooms
facts.quote: Two 4 person rooms, 2 single rooms and 3 double rooms.

facts.label: Levels
facts.value: All levels, from beginners to professional fighters
